response.justification: Despite a strong overall software engineering background, the candidate lacks demonstrated C++ experience on Windows in capital markets or fixed income domains — the core requirements for this role. His C++ exposure is limited to academic/prototype work (bachelor’s thesis) and outdated NI LabWindows usage, with no evidence of production-level fixed income systems, SQL Server/Oracle expertise, or financial domain knowledge.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across diverse technologies and domains
Strong DevOps and CI/CD practices demonstrated through multiple roles
Proven ability to lead open-source projects and technical workshops
concerns: No measurable professional C++ experience on Windows in financial systems
Missing explicit SQL Server/Oracle or fixed income derivatives domain exposure
Primary recent work is in TypeScript/Node.js, not C++ or capital markets
